entries.wording: The electronic information of the package has been received
entries.note: The order's registration, before the warehouse has the parcel.

entries.wording: The package has been sent out
entries.note: The shipper sends the parcel to the forwarder's operation centre, which has not received it yet.

entries.wording: The package has arrived at the operation center
entries.note: The forwarder's operation centre in Shenzhen receives the parcel.

entries.wording: The package leaves the operation center
entries.note: The parcel leaves the Shenzhen operation centre for export.
Israel Post's eCommerce System receives the parcel's manifest before it flies: a notice, not a movement.
China's export clearance.
The parcel reaches the departure airport, Hong Kong on the Israel line.
Israel Post's eCommerce System receives the flight's cargo manifest: a notice, not a movement.
The flight leaves the departure airport.
The flight reaches the destination airport, Tel Aviv on the Israel line.
Israel Post's copy of the landing at Ben Gurion airport.
Israel Post's terminal receives the parcel.
Israel Post's eCommerce sorting centre receives the parcel.

entries.wording: Arrival at inward office of exchange
entries.note: Israel Post's office of exchange receives the parcel.
Sorted to its delivery unit once customs has cleared it.
Israel's customs clear the parcel, so it goes on in transit.
An Israel Post delivery unit receives the parcel.

'Departure', at an Israel Post postman unit, on the tracking page. In the sample the same unit receives the parcel again ten minutes later and another unit delivers it, so it reads as a move, not as out for delivery.

'Return', at an Israel Post postman unit in the same second as its departure, on the tracking page. In the sample the same unit receives the parcel again ten minutes later and another unit delivers it, so the return stays inside Israel Post's network, not to the sender.
Israel Post's delivery.
